jobs.description: About this role Your team BlackRock Alternative Investors (BAI) brings together capabilities across real estate, infrastructure, credit, private equity, and hedge funds through a shared operating approach. The platform offers broad alternatives expertise and opportunities to collaborate with teams across the firm as the business continues to develop its alternatives-investment capabilities. The Alternatives Client Services (ACS) team supports BlackRock’s privately placed alternatives products, including hedge funds, funds of hedge funds, private credit, private equity, and real asset funds. The team supports investors throughout the fund lifecycle and is responsible for investor onboarding, report distribution, transfer-agency oversight, investor queries, internal and external reporting, and client-data management. Your role and impact As Vice President, you will help shape how ACS manages regulatory reporting, tax-reporting processes, client data, and digital investor onboarding. You will work across business lines and functions, including Legal and Tax, as well as with external transfer agents. Your work will support the future state of client data, strengthen investor-onboarding and tax-documentation processes, and improve Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) review workflows. This role offers the opportunity to lead cross-functional initiatives, address operational and regulatory challenges, and contribute to the continued development of the alternatives platform. Your responsibilities In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: Serve as the ACS subject matter expert and key cross-functional partner for global tax and regulatory reporting requirements, including the Alternative Investment Fund Managers Directive (AIFMD), Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA), Common Reporting Standard (CRS), Dodd-Frank reporting, Form PF, Form PQR, Form D, Blue Sky requirements, and relevant country-specific regulations. Research, evaluate, and implement new or revised regulatory reporting requirements for products and transactions. Assess current client-data platforms and user needs, document improvement opportunities, and develop a future-state roadmap that addresses operational constraints and dependencies. Partner with Legal and Tax to develop standardized subscription documentation that supports digital investor onboarding. Lead project management, integration testing, and implementation activities for digital investor-onboarding capabilities. Collaborate with external transfer agents and internal stakeholders to define efficient investor-onboarding and AML and KYC review workflows. Your experience Significant experience in a dynamic, deadline-oriented operations or client-service role, with expertise in alternative private funds. Experience leading cross-functional initiatives that mitigate risk, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen client service. Strong ability to organize, interpret, and analyze investor and portfolio data. Demonstrable people management experience A proactive, self-directed approach, with the ability to adapt priorities as business needs evolve. Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach to working across teams and organizational levels. Strong attention to detail, organizational discipline, and ownership of accurate, timely work through completion. Sound judgment in identifying issues, coordinating solutions, and escalating risks appropriately. Our benefits To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. Our hybrid work model BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. Guidance on AI use for candidates At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. About BlackRock At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com . We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn , Instagram , YouTube , X , and TikTok . BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected characteristics at law.

jobs.description: Garantire la sicurezza e il benessere dei nostri dipendenti sul luogo di lavoro è una priorità assoluta in Amazon. I nostri Safety Technician svolgono un ruolo fondamentale per renderlo possibile. Questo ruolo rappresenta un'opportunità per avviare la tua carriera nella sicurezza sul lavoro e crescere in un'azienda internazionale. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con i nostri esperti per monitorare il tuo sito, potendo così constatare ogni giorno la differenza che fai per il benessere delle persone. Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è Logistica, Trasporti e Merci. La posizione è inquadrata al livello 3 del CCNL di riferimento. Key job responsibilities - Eseguire valutazioni del rischio e audit. - Monitorare il sito per assicurarsi che i processi siano conformi alle procedure di sicurezza di Amazon. - Creare e aggiornare i report sulle metriche di sicurezza da sottoporre ai colleghi. - Collaborare con i colleghi di Operations e di tutta l'azienda su compiti relativi alla sicurezza e offrire indicazioni sui processi. - Supportare l'implementazione di nuove misure di sicurezza. A day in the life Lavorerai in uno dei nostri siti. Questo significa che potrai seguire da vicino ciò che accade e i colleghi potranno rivolgersi a te con domande durante i loro turni. Questo ruolo consiste nell'individuare potenziali problemi prima che si verifichino. Dedicherai molto tempo a controllare il sito e a osservare come le persone utilizzano le attrezzature. Comprendendo il funzionamento di ogni attività e di ogni macchinario, sarai in grado di individuare il modo migliore per mantenere i processi sicuri. Sarai anche una delle persone che mettono in atto i cambiamenti in materia di sicurezza, il che significa che lavorerai a stretto contatto con molte persone. Oltre alle tue mansioni quotidiane e settimanali, offrirai supporto al team Operations su attività ad hoc legate alla sicurezza. La sicurezza è fondamentale per Amazon, e ci aiuterai a raccogliere i dati essenziali che ci permettono di tenere sotto controllo i nostri processi e di prevenire qualsiasi problema. Condividerai questi dati con i colleghi di tutta l'azienda e collaborerai con altri team per assicurare che la sicurezza sia sempre al primo posto. About the team Il team Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire il benessere mentale e fisico dei nostri dipendenti sul luogo di lavoro. Il nostro team collabora con responsabili, associati e autorità locali in tutti i nostri siti, assicurando il rispetto delle politiche di Amazon e delle normative vigenti, e garantendo la sicurezza dei nostri ambienti di lavoro. Il team offre una varietà di opportunità, dai Safety Technician ai Programme Manager. Indipendentemente dal tuo ruolo, contribuirai allo sviluppo e all'implementazione della strategia di sicurezza sull'intera rete.

jobs.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Must be able to wear and use personal protective equipment (PPE), including harnesses with a total weight capacity of 300lbs. Technical Expertise : Strong technical and interpersonal skills along with a high level of initiative are required to be successful in this role. Problem-Solving Skills : The ability to identify and resolve issues quickly and effectively is important for maintaining smooth plant operations.
